q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: SELECT beer.name AS beer, MIN(serves.price) AS price, serves.bar AS bar FROM beer LEFT JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer GROUP BY beer.name, serves.bar HAVING COUNT(serves.bar) > 0 ORDER BY beer.name

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 does not properly handle the GROUP BY clause in the subquery, which can lead to incorrect results due to the use of aggregate functions without proper grouping.
